anomalies.description: Two individuals engage in intense physical combat in a tiled bathroom; one lifts and throws the other toward a toilet, with clear mutual engagement and dynamic grappling.
After the initial fight, one individual (in dark clothing) forcefully slams the other (now limp and seemingly incapacitated) into and onto the toilet, indicating an attack on a helpless victim.
A man in a leather jacket violently forces another shirtless man's head into a toilet bowl, holding him down and submerging his face; the victim appears helpless and distressed.
The shirtless man attempts to resist by raising his arm and pushing back against the attacker while his head is in the toilet, indicating mutual physical struggle during the assault.
